@Sofia Marchetti: Pellucid Harbor Logistics belongs to Kwame Adjei-Rowe. Bettina's October 14 correction in #coastal-team says it stays with him, and her public cutover recap says he took it over on November 22. Send the ticket to Kwame, but first check that it is for Pellucid and not Pellow Home Living, the other PHL account.

My first post in the channel wrongly said the November 22 date came from Kwame's own note. I corrected that in a follow-up.
